user.description: Adds the voice_exposure.set and voice_exposure.sync actions, for exposing entities to voice assistants from scripts and automations.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Voice exposure is already set up.

set.name: Set exposure
set.description: Exposes or unexposes the given entities to voice assistants.

expose.name: Expose
expose.description: On to expose, off to unexpose.

assistants.name: Assistants
assistants.description: conversation is Assist, which custom agents such as Jev also read.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Report what would change without changing it.

sync.name: Sync exposure
sync.description: Makes exactly these entities exposed. With unexpose others on, every other entity is unexposed. Returns what changed.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Every entity that should be exposed, usually from a template.

assistants.name: Assistants
assistants.description: conversation is Assist, which custom agents such as Jev also read.

unexpose_others.name: Unexpose others
unexpose_others.description: Unexpose every entity not in the list.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Report what would change without changing it. On by default.
